summary: Nova Home Panel Layout Fix VERIFIED. All 5 reported issues addressed: (1) Desktop layout regression fixed - panel 392x740px with message list 385px visible; (2) Desktop conversation visibility working - auto-scroll to latest message confirmed; (3) Responsive usability verified on mobile (390x844) and tablet (768x1024) - panel stays within viewport; (4) Secondary sections (feedback, status, curation, GPS) no longer crowd out conversation - GPS hidden on mobile as expected; (5) Send flow working for authenticated admin user across all viewports.

test_2_desktop_conversation_visibility.description: After sending message, assistant reply visible without manual scrolling
test_2_desktop_conversation_visibility.evidence: Screenshot nova_after_send.png shows conversation thread with assistant reply

test_5_secondary_sections_not_crowding.description: Feedback panel, status indicator, curation strip, GPS block do not crowd out conversation
test_5_secondary_sections_not_crowding.evidence: Message list heights: Desktop 385px, Mobile 319px, Tablet 345px - all >= 200px minimum

test_6_send_flow_authenticated.description: Admin user can send message and receive assistant reply on all viewports
test_6_send_flow_authenticated.evidence: All after_send screenshots show assistant responses

layout_fix_verification.root_cause_identified: Panel allocated too much fixed vertical space to secondary UI (feedback card, status/detail text, curation strip, GPS card, composer area) inside fixed-height panel, and auto-scroll was not strong enough
layout_fix_verification.fix_applied: Larger/taller panel bounds, reduced bottom offset, stronger scroll-to-latest behavior, message list flexGrow+justifyContent=end, feedback panel dismissible with 'Later', phone view hides GPS card
